subject: Copywriting
title: Headlines Carry Everything
description: A fast breakdown of Headlines Carry Everything for builders.

hook.text: Ogilvy said five times as many people read the headline as the body.

buildup.text: Every legend invested disproportionate time on headlines.

discovery.text: The headline does the heavy lifting: it grabs attention, promises a benefit, and selects the right audience.

twist.text: In digital, the headline IS the ad. A tweet, a subject line, a Google ad—all headlines competing for one click.

climax.text: If the headline fails, nothing else matters. Body copy, design, and price are irrelevant to someone who never clicked.

punchline.text: Headline fails, nothing else matters. Write it last, perfect it first.

quiz.question: According to Ogilvy, how many more people read the headline vs body copy?
